groups.name: Better Call Saul
groups.explanation: Mike Ehrmantraut (major character), Albuquerque (primary setting), Kim Wexler (major character and protagonist's partner), and Jonathan Banks (actor who plays Mike Ehrmantraut) are all central to Better Call Saul. Note: Jonathan Banks is not the same tile as a character name, and Mike Ehrmantraut replaces Saul Goodman to avoid trivial actor-character linking with Bob Odenkirk, who does not appear on this board.

groups.name: Early 1990s prestige broadcast dramas that won a Peabody Award
groups.explanation: Twin Peaks (ABC, premiered 1990, Peabody winner), Northern Exposure (CBS, premiered 1990, Peabody winner), Picket Fences (CBS, premiered 1992, Peabody winner), and I'll Fly Away (NBC, premiered 1991, Peabody winner) are all critically lauded early-1990s American broadcast dramas that received Peabody Awards during their original runs. This replaces Fargo (which is FX and premiered in 2014, inconsistent with the others in era and network type) with I'll Fly Away, a legitimate fit.
